why.title: A New Way to Research Trademarks in Afghanistan
why.p1: Trademark information is an important part of business and intellectual-property research. Yet finding and reviewing published trademark information can be time-consuming when information is distributed across Gazette publications and documents.
why.p2: TMistan was created to make that research process more accessible by bringing searchable published trademark records into one modern digital platform.

about.title: About TMistan
about.subtitle: Search and Explore Trademark Records in Afghanistan
about.intro: TMistan is a platform for searching and exploring trademark records published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan.
about.intro2: It brings these published records together in one place so that they can be searched and reviewed through a simple, organized digital experience.
about.findIntro: Each record on TMistan presents the information as published, including:
find: Publication information (Official Gazette number and page)
about.purpose: TMistan was created to make trademark information published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan easier to find. Instead of reviewing printed issues page by page, users can search across the published records by keyword and refine the results.
about.source: Every record on TMistan is based on a publication in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan and shows its source: the gazette number and the page on which it was published. Where a piece of information is not available in the published record, it is shown as N/A.
about.audienceIntro: TMistan is intended for anyone who needs to look up trademark records in Afghanistan, including:
about.tool: TMistan is a digital research and information tool. It is not a government authority, does not register trademarks and does not replace the Official Gazette or the responsible authorities. For official or legal purposes, please refer to the original publication.

help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: How to use TMistan.
help.a1: Enter a keyword in the search box — a trademark name, applicant name, serial number (for example 1011-002), Official Gazette number (for example 1011), class number or a word from the goods and services — and press Search.
help.q2: How do I refine the results?
help.a2: After a search, filters appear above the results: Class, Gazette, Applicant, Application Type, Date Range and Advanced (mark name, serial number, goods and services, fuzzy matching). You can also sort the results and switch between the grid and table views. Use “Clear All” to remove the filters.
help.q3: How do I open a record?
help.a3: Click a result card or a row in the table. The record page shows the trademark name, serial number, applicant, address, class, goods and services, application type, publication date and the trademark image where one is available.
help.q4: What does the source information mean?
help.a4: Every record shows the Official Gazette (OG) number and the page on which it was published, for example “Source: OG 1011 — Page 3”. Information that is not available in the published record is shown as N/A.
help.a5: The serial number identifies a record within a gazette issue — “1011-002” is the second record published in Official Gazette 1011.
help.q6: Why does a record have no image?
help.a6: Images are shown where one is available for the record. Records without an image show “No image on file for this trademark”.
help.a7: “Download Record” on a record page opens your browser’s print dialog with a clean, printable version of the record. Choose “Save as PDF” to download it, or print it directly.

g.class: Class — one of the 45 Nice Classification categories of goods (1–34) and services (35–45).
g.gazette: Gazette — an issue of the Official Gazette in which trademark applications are published.
g.objection: Objection deadline — the last date on which a third party may oppose the application.
g.applicant: Applicant — the person or company that filed the trademark application.

legal.terms: TMistan reproduces trademark publications from the Official Gazette of Afghanistan for research and information purposes. The printed gazette remains the authoritative publication. Records are provided as transcribed; TMistan makes no warranty as to completeness or accuracy and accepts no liability for decisions made on the basis of this information.
legal.privacy: Public pages of TMistan do not require an account and do not collect personal data beyond standard server logs. Administrator accounts are used only to maintain the registry. No data is sold or shared with third parties.
disclaimer: TMistan is an independent research platform and a product of Masnad Law Firm. It is not the official Government trademark registry of Afghanistan and is not a substitute for official legal records and procedures.

Records are reproduced as published in the Official Gazette of Afghanistan and may differ from the printed publication through transcription. TMistan does not perform official trademark clearance, does not guarantee the availability of any trademark, and does not provide legal advice.
For legal or procedural matters, refer to the official publication and the responsible authorities, or seek professional advice.

trademarks.features: {{count}} image(s) indexed for Search by Image.
trademarks.archiveText: Archived records disappear from the public website, search results and statistics immediately. The data, images and history stay in the database and can be restored at any time.
trademarks.restoreText: The records become visible again on the public website and in search results.
trademarks.deleteText: The selected trademark records are removed from the database together with their linked images and image-search features. Records that are not selected are never touched.
trademarks.deleteDependents: {{images}} linked image row(s) will be deleted as well; their Storage files are queued for removal and reported under Orphaned Files if Storage rejects the deletion.
trademarks.deleted: {{count}} record(s) deleted, {{images}} image row(s) removed, {{queued}} Storage file(s) queued for cleanup.

images.subtitle: Every image row in the database with its Storage file, linked record and provenance. Deleting an image never deletes the trademark record.
images.unmatchedSubtitle: Image rows that are not linked to a trademark record, plus the files that image imports could not match to a serial number.
images.searchPlaceholder: Serial, file name, storage path, mark name…
images.deleteText: The image rows are removed from the database and their Storage files are queued for removal. The trademark records stay untouched and will show the neutral placeholder.
images.deleteDependents: Search-by-image features of these images are removed. Trademark records are never deleted by this action.
images.deleted: {{count}} image(s) deleted; {{queued}} Storage file(s) queued for cleanup.
images.unmatchedFilesTitle: Files reported as unmatched by image imports
images.unmatchedFilesHint: These files were never uploaded: no record with the serial number in the file name existed at import time (or several did). Fix the file name or import the record first, then upload again.
images.noUnmatchedFiles: No unmatched files have been reported.

history.subtitle: Every Excel/CSV and image import with its counts, failures and provenance. Deleting an import record never deletes trademark data; deleting the records of a batch removes only what that batch created.
history.retention: Retention: remove finished import records older than
history.purgeTitle: Remove import records older than {{days}} days?
history.purgeText: Only the history entries and their item logs are removed. Trademark records and images are never affected by retention cleanup.
history.purgePreview: {{jobs}} import record(s) and {{items}} item log line(s) would be removed.
history.createdHint: Rows that still exist and were created by this import (reliable provenance).
history.provenanceHint: This import ran before per-row provenance was recorded; only creation provenance is available.
history.noRecords: No records are attributed to this batch.
history.cancelText: The import is marked as failed and the database refuses any further rows for it. Rows already written stay in place; re-importing the same file later updates them without creating duplicates.
history.deleteJobText: Only the history entry and its item log are removed. The trademark records and images it created stay in the database (their provenance ID is kept).
history.deleteJobDependents: {{created}} record(s)/image(s) created by this import are NOT deleted. {{items}} item log line(s) are removed.
history.jobDeleted: Import record deleted ({{items}} item log line(s) removed).
history.deleteRecordsTitle: Delete the records created by this import?
history.deleteRecordsText: Removes only the trademark records and images that "{{file}}" created. Records that already existed and were merely updated by this import are never deleted.
history.previewModified: Created by this import but modified later
history.includeModified: Also delete the {{count}} record(s) that were modified after this import (by a later import or manually).
history.noProvenance: No rows are attributed to this import. It either created nothing, or it ran before provenance tracking — nothing will be deleted.
history.recordsDeleted: {{trademarks}} record(s) and {{images}} image(s) deleted; {{queued}} Storage file(s) queued; {{skipped}} modified record(s) kept.
history.note1: Deleting a source file is not possible here: uploaded Excel/ZIP files are never stored — only their rows and images are.
history.note2: Counts are taken from the import itself; "Created" is recounted from the database so it reflects what still exists.
history.note3: Imports still running after the browser was closed can be cancelled; the database then rejects any late rows.

storage.subtitle: Keeps the database and Supabase Storage consistent: files of deleted records are removed here, orphaned files can be found and deleted, and broken image references are listed.
storage.queueHint: Files of deleted records and images. The database never reports a file as removed before Storage confirms it; failures stay here and can be retried.
storage.scanHint: Lists the bucket trademark-images and compares it with the image rows. Nothing is deleted by the scan.
storage.truncated: The listing was cut off at the safety limit; results are partial. Run the cleanup queue and scan again.
storage.orphansHint: Files in Storage that no image row references. They are not visible on the website. Files already queued for cleanup are marked and handled by the queue.
storage.deleteText: Each file is re-checked against the database right before deletion; a file that became referenced in the meantime is skipped. The operation is written to the audit log with the exact paths.
storage.missingTitle: Image rows whose file is missing ({{count}})
storage.missingHint: These database rows point to a Storage path that does not exist. Re-upload the image (same serial number) or delete the row from Trademark Images.

audit.subtitle: Who did what, when, to which records. Administrative actions record ids, serial numbers, Storage paths, batch and result; row changes are the trigger-based before/after log.
audit.immutable: Both logs are append-only: no role can modify or delete entries, and a database trigger refuses changes even from the owner.
